children: Robert O. Kraft, a Director, reported a sale of Medpace common stock on 2026-08-26. The shares were sold at a weighted average price of $617.81 per share. The total sale amount reported was $2,383,510. Following the reported transaction, Kraft directly owns 955 shares of common stock. The reporting form notes the weighted average price reflects multiple transactions ranging from $617.73 to $618.43 and that full pricing information will be provided upon request.
